name: Ito
source:
Ito is one of Kuro's childhood friends and watched him grow up, making him play the role of a big brother. He's happy to see him mature but also feels rather lonely about it sometimes.

Race: Yellowfin Tuna (Hence why "4" in human years is an adult age for him)

Special skill: He can jump higher than even seagulls

Origin: Somewhere overseas

Favorite time: When young children are happy

[Translated from [url=https://tonleiter-p6.com/fantasticstrans/index_magu.html#character]the official website[/url]]
